item.title: Master the Referral Request Process 🤝 • Identify the right person for the referral. • Reach out with a personalized message. • Use: “I’m exploring roles at XYZ and value your insight.” • Explain how they know your work or skills. • Offer to provide any needed information. Who in your network could provide a powerful referral for you? #networking #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
